text.tspan: Inside every controller: informer → work queue → worker
Controllers never call each other: the Deployment controller just writes a ReplicaSet;
the ReplicaSet controller sees it on its own watch and creates Pods.
One active copy at a time via leader election (a Lease). Every operator you write uses this same pattern.
write the fix (create / update / delete objects)
